description: RC4.2: FilterScreenProbes and the platform SSGI feeding InterpolateScreenProbes: a uniform field unchanged by the filter, the filter against its CPU port on depth edges, SSGI on an open plane (visibility 1, bent normal = normal, no near-field light), SSGI in a corner against the analytic visibility and bent-normal tilt, and a near-field furnace (every direction L reads pi L).
